    <script>
        // --- 暗黑版配置 ---
        const CONFIG = {
            count: 5000,           // 粒子数量增加，黑色背景能容纳更多细节
            color: 0xffffff,       // 粒子纯白
            bg: 0x000000,          // 背景纯黑
            speed: 0.0005,         // 整体旋转速度
            flowSpeed: 0.002       // 粒子在环上的流动速度
        };

        // --- 变量 ---
        let scene, camera, renderer, mesh;
        let dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
        
        // 核心时间变量
        let time = 0;
        
        // 模拟神经脉冲引擎
        let neuralPulse = 0;
        let targetPulse = 0;
        let glitchMode = false;

        init();
        animate();

        function init() {
            // 1. 场景
            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            scene.background = new THREE.Color(CONFIG.bg);
            // 黑色雾气：让远处的粒子隐没在黑暗中，制造深渊感
            scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(CONFIG.bg, 0.02);

            // 2. 相机
            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 100);
            camera.position.set(0, 0, 35);

            // 3. 灯光系统 (为黑色背景定制)
            const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.2); // 环境光很弱
            scene.add(ambientLight);

            // 主光：强烈的白色聚光灯
            const spotLight = new THREE.SpotLight(0xffffff, 2);
            spotLight.position.set(20, 20, 20);
            spotLight.angle = 0.5;
            spotLight.penumbra = 1;
            scene.add(spotLight);

            // 蓝色边缘光：给白色粒子一点点冷峻的科技感反射
            const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xaaccff, 1.5);
            rimLight.position.set(-10, 0, -20); // 从背后打光
            scene.add(rimLight);

            // 4. 渲染器
            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false });
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            // 5. 几何体设计
            // 使用细长的“针”状几何体，模拟数据流
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.08, 0.08, 1.2); 
            const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: CONFIG.color,
                roughness: 0.4,  // 稍微粗糙一点，为了更好地捕捉光线
                metalness: 0.8,  // 高金属感，像银针
            });

            mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, CONFIG.count);
            scene.add(mesh);

            window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);
        }

        // --- 神经脉冲引擎 (保持你喜欢的算法逻辑) ---
        function updateNeuralEngine() {
            // 随机触发“故障”或“平静”
            if (Math.random() < 0.01) {
                targetPulse = Math.random() * 2; // 突变目标
                glitchMode = Math.random() < 0.15; // 15% 概率故障
            } else {
                targetPulse *= 0.98; // 缓慢衰减归零
            }
            // 平滑过渡
            neuralPulse += (targetPulse - neuralPulse) * 0.05;
        }

        // --- 核心数学形态：Torus Knot (环面纽结) ---
        function getKnotPosition(u, v, target) {
            // p 和 q 决定了结的缠绕方式 (3, 4) 是一个很美的比例
            const p = 3;
            const q = 4;
            const r = 10 + neuralPulse * 2; // 环的半径随脉冲呼吸

            // 环面纽结公式
            const radius = 3 + Math.cos(q * u) * 1.5;
            const x = (r + radius * Math.cos(v)) * Math.cos(p * u);
            const y = (r + radius * Math.cos(v)) * Math.sin(p * u);
            const z = radius * Math.sin(v) + Math.sin(u * 10 + time) * neuralPulse; // Z轴震动

            target.set(x, y, z);
        }

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            time += CONFIG.speed * (1 + neuralPulse); // 脉冲越强，时间越快
            updateNeuralEngine();

            // 整体旋转
            mesh.rotation.y += 0.002;
            mesh.rotation.z += 0.001;

            let i = 0;
            const timeOffset = Date.now() * CONFIG.flowSpeed;

            for (let x = 0; x < CONFIG.count; x++) {
                // 计算每个粒子在“流”中的位置
                // u: 沿着大环的位置
                // v: 沿着管壁的位置
                const u = (x / CONFIG.count) * Math.PI * 2 + timeOffset * 0.1;
                const v = (x % 50) / 50 * Math.PI * 2;

                // 获取当前位置
                const pos = new THREE.Vector3();
                getKnotPosition(u, v, pos);

                // 获取"稍微前面一点"的位置，用于让粒子"看向"前方
                // 这让几何体顺着流向排列，像鱼群或数据流
                const nextPos = new THREE.Vector3();
                getKnotPosition(u + 0.05, v, nextPos);

                // 加上一点随机噪波 (Glitch Effect)
                if (glitchMode) {
                    const noise = (Math.random() - 0.5) * neuralPulse * 3;
                    pos.x += noise;
                    pos.y += noise;
                    pos.z += noise;
                }

                dummy.position.copy(pos);
                
                // 关键：让粒子朝向流动的方向
                dummy.lookAt(nextPos);
                
                // 动态缩放：脉冲强时，粒子变长变细
                const scale = 1 + Math.sin(u * 10 + time) * 0.5;
                dummy.scale.set(1, 1, scale + neuralPulse);

                dummy.updateMatrix();
                mesh.setMatrixAt(i++, dummy.matrix);
            }

            mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        function onWindowResize() {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }
    </script>

    <script type="x-shader/x-fragment" id="fragmentShader">
        uniform float uTime;
        uniform vec2 uResolution;
        uniform vec2 uMouse;

        varying vec2 vUv;

        // --- SDF Functions (数学建模) ---
        
        // 旋转矩阵
        mat2 rot(float a) {
            float s = sin(a), c = cos(a);
            return mat2(c, -s, s, c);
        }

        // Gyroid 结构: 这种无限重复的曲面是 Raymarching 的拿手好戏
        float sdGyroid(vec3 p, float scale, float thickness, float bias) {
            p *= scale;
            return abs(dot(sin(p), cos(p.zxy)) - bias) / scale - thickness;
        }

        // 场景定义: 融合球体与 Gyroid
        float map(vec3 p) {
            // 鼠标互动: 稍微旋转整个空间
            vec3 p_rot = p;
            p_rot.yz *= rot(uMouse.y * 3.0);
            p_rot.xz *= rot(uMouse.x * 3.0);

            // 基础球体
            float sphere = length(p_rot) - 1.5;

            // 动态噪声/Gyroid
            // 让它随着时间移动
            vec3 q = p_rot + vec3(uTime * 0.2, uTime * 0.1, 0.0); 
            float g = sdGyroid(q, 4.0, 0.05, 0.0);

            // 布尔运算: 球体 INTERSECT Gyroid
            // max(a, b) 在 SDF 中意味着取交集
            // 我们混合一下，让它看起来像是在球体内部生长的结构
            float d = max(sphere, g * 0.8); 
            
            // 再添加一点扭曲
            d += sin(p_rot.x * 10.0 + uTime) * 0.02;

            return d;
        }

        // --- Raymarching Loop ---

        // 计算法线 (用于光照)
        vec3 getNormal(vec3 p) {
            vec2 e = vec2(0.001, 0.0);
            return normalize(vec3(
                map(p + e.xyy) - map(p - e.xyy),
                map(p + e.yxy) - map(p - e.yxy),
                map(p + e.yyx) - map(p - e.yyx)
            ));
        }

        // 光线步进主函数
        float raymarch(vec3 ro, vec3 rd) {
            float dO = 0.0; // 距离原点的距离
            for(int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                vec3 p = ro + rd * dO;
                float dS = map(p);
                dO += dS;
                if(dO > 20.0 || abs(dS) < 0.001) break;
            }
            return dO;
        }

        void main() {
            // 坐标归一化 (-1 到 1), 并修正长宽比
            vec2 uv = (gl_FragCoord.xy * 2.0 - uResolution.xy) / uResolution.y;

            // 相机设置
            vec3 ro = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -4.0); // Ray Origin (相机位置)
            vec3 rd = normalize(vec3(uv, 1.5)); // Ray Direction (视野)

            // --- 渲染 (Rendering with Chromatic Aberration) ---
            
            vec3 col = vec3(0.0);
            
            // 我们进行三次采样，稍微偏移光线方向，模拟 RGB 色散
            // 这就是让材质看起来像高级玻璃/水晶的关键
            float dR = raymarch(ro, rd); // Red channel distance
            float dG = raymarch(ro, rd + vec3(0.002, 0.0, 0.0)); // Green (slight offset)
            float dB = raymarch(ro, rd + vec3(0.004, 0.0, 0.0)); // Blue (more offset)

            // 如果击中了物体 (距离小于最大距离)
            if(dR < 20.0) {
                vec3 p = ro + rd * dR;
                vec3 n = getNormal(p);
                
                // 简单的光照模型 (Rim Light + Diffuse)
                vec3 lightPos = vec3(2.0, 2.0, -3.0);
                vec3 l = normalize(lightPos - p);
                float diff = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
                
                // 菲涅尔边缘光 (Fresnel)
                float fresnel = pow(1.0 + dot(rd, n), 3.0);

                // 红色通道
                col.r = diff * 0.1 + fresnel * 2.0;
            }
            
            if(dG < 20.0) {
                vec3 p = ro + (rd + vec3(0.002, 0.0, 0.0)) * dG;
                vec3 n = getNormal(p);
                float fresnel = pow(1.0 + dot(rd, n), 3.0);
                // 绿色通道
                col.g = fresnel * 2.0; 
            }

            if(dB < 20.0) {
                vec3 p = ro + (rd + vec3(0.004, 0.0, 0.0)) * dB;
                vec3 n = getNormal(p);
                float fresnel = pow(1.0 + dot(rd, n), 3.0);
                // 蓝色通道
                col.b = fresnel * 3.0; // 蓝色稍微强一点，增加冷感
            }

            // 背景辉光 (Vignette & Glow)
            // 如果没有击中物体，给一点微妙的背景色
            float glow = length(uv);
            col += vec3(0.02, 0.02, 0.05) * (1.0 - glow);

            // Gamma 校正
            col = pow(col, vec3(0.4545));

            gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
        }
    </script>

<script type="x-shader/x-vertex" id="vertexshader">
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uPixelRatio;
    
    attribute float aScale;
    attribute vec3 aRandomness;
    
    varying vec3 vColor;

    void main() {
        vec3 newPos = position;
        
        // === 1. 疯狂的漩涡运动 ===
        float radius = length(newPos.xz);
        float angle = atan(newPos.z, newPos.x);
        
        // 速度加快：uTime * 0.8 (之前是 0.5)
        // 扭曲度加大：15.0 (之前是 10.0)
        float angleOffset = (15.0 / (radius + 0.01)) * sin(uTime * 0.3) + uTime * 0.8;
        angle += angleOffset;
        
        newPos.x = radius * cos(angle);
        newPos.z = radius * sin(angle);
        
        // === 2. 剧烈的上下波动 ===
        // 振幅加大：* 0.8 (之前是 0.5)
        newPos.y += sin(uTime * 2.0 + radius * 1.5) * 0.8;
        
        // === 3. 爆炸般的随机抖动 ===
        newPos += aRandomness * sin(uTime * 2.0 + newPos.x);

        vec4 mvPosition = modelViewMatrix * vec4(newPos, 1.0);
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;
        
        // === 4. 巨型粒子 ===
        // 基础大小改为 40.0 (之前是 8.0)，极具视觉冲击力
        gl_PointSize = (40.0 * aScale * uPixelRatio) * (1.0 / -mvPosition.z);
        
        // === 5. 高能配色 ===
        // 核心：电光蓝 (0.2, 1.0, 1.0)
        // 边缘：赛博粉 (1.0, 0.1, 0.5)
        vec3 colorInner = vec3(0.2, 1.0, 1.0); 
        vec3 colorOuter = vec3(1.0, 0.1, 0.5);
        
        float mixStrength = smoothstep(0.0, 6.0, radius + sin(uTime));
        vColor = mix(colorInner, colorOuter, mixStrength);
    }
</script>

<!-- Fragment Shader: 片元着色器 -->
<script type="x-shader/x-fragment" id="fragmentshader">
    varying vec3 vColor;

    void main() {
        // 计算光点距离
        float distanceToCenter = distance(gl_PointCoord, vec2(0.5));
        
        // === 6. 超强辉光 ===
        // 0.1 / distance (之前是 0.05)，亮度翻倍

        gl_FragColor = vec4(vColor, strength);

    let scene, camera, renderer, material, particles;
    // 粒子数量：减少到 25000，因为粒子变大了，太密会变成白茫茫一片
    const count = 25000; 

    function init() {
        scene = new THREE.Scene();
        
        camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 100);
        camera.position.set(0, 2, 3); // 相机拉远一点，看清全貌
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

        renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
        const randomness = new Float32Array(count * 3);
        const scales = new Float32Array(count);

        for(let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const i3 = i * 3;
            const radius = Math.random() * 7 + Math.random(); 
            const spinAngle = radius * 3.0;
            const branchAngle = (i % 3) * ((2 * Math.PI) / 3);

            // 让粒子分布更散乱一点，增加体积感
            const randomX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.0;
            const randomY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.0;
            const randomZ = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.0;

            positions[i3] = Math.cos(branchAngle + spinAngle) * radius + randomX;
            positions[i3 + 1] = randomY * 1.5; 
            positions[i3 + 2] = Math.sin(branchAngle + spinAngle) * radius + randomZ;

            randomness[i3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.0;
            randomness[i3+1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.0;
            randomness[i3+2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.0;

            scales[i] = Math.random();
        }

        geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
        geometry.setAttribute('aRandomness', new THREE.BufferAttribute(randomness, 3));
        geometry.setAttribute('aScale', new THREE.BufferAttribute(scales, 1));

        material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
            depthWrite: false,
            blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, // 叠加发光模式
            vertexColors: true,
            vertexShader: document.getElementById('vertexshader').textContent,
            fragmentShader: document.getElementById('fragmentshader').textContent,
            uniforms: {
                uTime: { value: 0 },
                uPixelRatio: { value: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2) }
            }
        });

        particles = new THREE.Points(geometry, material);
        scene.add(particles);

        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);
        animate();
    }

    function onWindowResize() {
        camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        material.uniforms.uPixelRatio.value = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2);
    }

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
        const elapsedTime = clock.getElapsedTime();
        material.uniforms.uTime.value = elapsedTime;
        
        // 整体场景也在缓慢旋转
        scene.rotation.y = elapsedTime * 0.1;
        
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    init();
